definitions.downloads: Recorded download-link clicks, not confirmed file transfers.
definitions.impressions: Recorded appearances of resources in search results.
definitions.latency: Response times for recorded API requests. Percentiles cannot be added or averaged across months; historical values may come from preserved baselines.
definitions.requests: Recorded API requests, including automated traffic and probes.
definitions.searches: Recorded search events; repeated searches count separately.
definitions.sourceClicks: Recorded source-site link clicks, not confirmed visits or transfers.
definitions.trackedVisits: An estimate from merged tab-scoped token sketches; not unique people. Daily estimates must not be added to obtain a period estimate.
definitions.views: Recorded resource-view events, not all website pageviews or unique people.

limitations: Reconciliation establishes consistency of recorded data, not capture of every real-world interaction.
Coverage is the report's recorded declaration, not an independent certification.
Independent baseline documents and deployed archive durability were not verified by this packet.
This packet covers the aggregate report only. Detailed rankings, member attribution, client classifications and supplemental dashboard data are outside its verification scope.
Catalog attribution uses captured metadata, which need not represent month-end inventory.
Checksums detect changed content; they are not signatures or independent attestations.
